quarterly_data.quarter: AMD press release: AMD to Acquire World Labs to Advance the Future of AI (09-28-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: AMD entered into a definitive agreement to acquire World Labs, an AI model and research lab led by Dr. Fei-Fei Li that develops spatial-intelligence models that generate, reconstruct and simulate interactive 3D environments from text, image and video inputs, as well as technology for robotic learning and simulation. AMD says the acquisition brings a team of researchers and model experts to strengthen its ability to develop AI hardware, software and systems around the needs of emerging models and to help shape its future technology roadmaps; after close the World Labs team will continue to focus on AI model research. The transaction is expected to close by the end of 2026, subject to regulatory approvals. CEO Lisa Su: 'Building the compute platforms for the next generation of AI requires a deep understanding of how models are evolving... Together, we can use that insight to develop the hardware, software and systems that will power the next generation of AI and strengthen the open AI ecosystem.'
quarterly_data.figure: expected to close by the end of 2026
